entities.name: Milena Králíčková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milena Králíčková is a Czech physician and university professor, specializing in histology and embryology. From February 2022 to January 2026, she served as the Rector of Charles University in Prague, Czech Republic, making her the first woman to hold this position.
